{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:Pampy-SWFacebook.png]] |name=Pampy |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Twi'lek]] {{C|[[Rutian]]}}''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Blue]] |skin=Blue |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]]{{Film|I}} **[[Galactic Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Pampy''' was a [[Rutian]] [[Twi'lek]] who served as a loyal [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]]. In [[32 BBY]], Pampy was present in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] when [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]]. By [[22 BBY]], Pampy was serving Taa alongside [[Supi]], another aide of Taa with whom Pampy had a bitter rivalry. The pair accompanied the senator his fellow members of the [[Loyalist Committee]] to a meeting in the [[Emperor's office|office]] of Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. ==Biography== ===Senatorial aide=== {{Quote|If this body is not capable of action, I suggest new leadership is needed. I move for a Vote of No Confidence in Chancellor Valorum's leadership.|Queen Padmé Amidala|audio=VoteOfNoConfidence-TPM.flac|}} [[File:OrnFreeTaaPod-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Pampy served as aide to Senator Orn Free Taa.]] Pampy was a [[Rutian]] [[Twi'lek]] who served as an [[aide]] to [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]], the corrupt representative of the Twi'lek [[homeworld]] [[Ryloth]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].{{Databank|orn-free-taa|Orn Free Taa}} In [[32 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]]. Pampy was on [[Coruscant]], [[capital]] of the Republic, with Taa and attended a session of the Senate with him in which [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo]] asked for intervention in the [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of her homeworld by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army|forces]] of the [[Trade Federation]]. Inside the [[Galactic Senate Chamber|main chamber]] of the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]], Pampy sat with another [[Orn Free Taa's partner|Twi'lek aide]] and Taa in a [[repulsorpod]] while the Trade Federation objected to the queen's claims and called for a committee to be formed in order to investigate the claim. When Amidala then called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]] due to his inability to aid her people, Pampy quickly stood as Taa and other senators rose and began to clamor about the vote. Pampy then lent in to listen to something being said by the other Twi'lek aide before [[Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda]] called for order. ===Loyalist Committee=== {{Quote|«The Loyalist Committee has arrived, Your Honor.''»
"''Good.''"
[Dar Wac contiues to speak in an alien language]
"''Send them in.|Dar Wac announces the arrival of Supi and the committee to Palpatine|quotestart=0|audio=DarWac-AOTC.flac|{{Film|II}}}} [[File:LoyalistCommittee-AOTC.png|thumb|right|300px|Pampy visited Palpatine's office with the Loyalist Committee.]] Pampy was still serving as aide to Taa ten [[Standard year|years]] later in [[22 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY]]. while he was a member of the [[Loyalist Committee]] during the [[Separatist Crisis]], in which numerous [[star system]]s began to defect from the Republic. She and [[Supi]], another Twi'lek aide to Taa, accompanied the senator and other members of the committee, including Amidala and Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]], to a meeting with Supreme Chancellor [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and Amedda in the [[Emperor's office|chancellor's office]] on Coruscant. After Palpatine's assistant [[Dar Wac]] alerted him to their arrival, the Chancellor had Pampy and the others sent into his office just as he was finishing up a meeting with the [[Jedi High Council]]. Before the committee could take their seats and start the meeting, [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] offered his condolences to Amidala after a recent [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt]] on her life, which prompted Palpatine to request additional Jedi security for Amidala. The Jedi consented to assigning [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to protect her and then left after which the committee moved to take their seats. ==Personality and traits== Pampy served Taa loyally but had a bitter rivalry with Supi, vying with the other aide for the senator's favor, although Taa was dissatisfied with any companion that was not a red-skinned Twi'lek [[Gender|female]].{{EncyclopediaCite|Chancellors, Senators and States Persons of the Republic}} Pampy had [[Color|cerulean]] skin and blue [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== While in the Senate and when meeting with Palpatine, Pampy wore a silver [[Clothing|dress]] and a piece of silver headwear with an embedded blue [[Crystal|gem]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Human_aides_of_Taa.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Pampy replaced Orn Free Taa's human aides, as seen in the theatrical cut of ''The Phantom Menace''.]] Pampy first appeared on the [[Wikipedia:DVD|DVD]] release{{Film|I}} — Depth Commentaries of the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], where she was portrayed by [[Amy Allen]].{{Instagram|username=amyallen_jedi|url=p/C4Js-Y7vuFB|name=[[Amy Allen]]|date=2024-03-05|quote=Twi’lek Tuesday!🩵 Fun fact: Another blue Twi’lek that came to be @ilmvfx. Thankfully my parents kept everything and my mom had these pics saved in a binder she started for me when I started doing conventions in 2002🤣 This was a replacement shot for Episode 1 - The Phantom Menace DVD release. We did this on one of the sound stages at Industrial Light & Magic. I was a senators aide and that costume was heavy, detailed, beautiful and I loved it!🩶 I just sent these pics to @deckard100 - he had never seen them before!! Danny Wagner did my makeup a few times, always a good time in that makeup room transforming!|archivedate=20240801134243}} The character and an additional Twi'lek aide were added to the Senate scene, replacing two human aides portrayed by [[Trisha Biggar]] and [[Iain McCaig]], that had appeared in the theatrical cut. While filming for the [[2002]] prequel trilogy film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the extras playing Pampy and Supi wore mitts between scenes in order to avoid spreading their makeup around.{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/01/imageattack20030123.html|series=Image Attack|text=Colorful Assistants}} In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Pampy was identified by the article "Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind", written by [[Tim Veekhoven]] and posted on [[StarWars.com]] on [[August 19]], [[2014]].{{SW|url=news/die-wanna-wanga-encounters-of-the-twilek-kind|text=Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind|nolive=1}} The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the character was first identified as [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]] in the [[2001]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' by [[James Luceno]].''[[Cloak of Deception]]''
